title: freeze RC19 installable image and first-user install authority contract

criteria: Contract freezes gate order from RC18 isolated image readiness through reproducible installable image artifact, installer media, first-user install target, first boot, local/offline channel, post-install update/rollback, support/recovery, consumer smoke, and final audit.
Contract states first-user install effects may run only inside disposable target evidence until a later milestone explicitly authorizes host install.

Contract forbids external mirror/frontend/nginx/signer/object-storage/private-key/support-upload/recovery-execution/remote-dispatch/host-rootfs/host-boot/production-ring authority and keeps production_ready_claim=false.
